recs.x:
Being pleasant is one of my personal rules/goals for life.

But it is interesting to analyze great leaders who have been jerks. This 30 minute Youtube documentary on the topic is very interesting: "DICKS: Do you need to be one to be a successful leader?" [link]

I wonder why the author did not feel persuaded to mention our current poster child of arseholism, the quintessential kind: Donald Trump.
